summary.en: Makes steam by heating water.
summary.zh: 加热水，产生蒸汽。

detail.en:
Heat crosses the boiler wall into the water; the furnace space stays separate. This is a generic low-pressure boiler study, not the preserved original boiler. [S7]

The shell radius and length are display design dimensions, not instructions for building or operating a boiler. [S1]
detail.zh:
热量穿过锅炉壁传给水，炉膛与水的空间分开。这里采用通用低压锅炉的示意外形，不称为保存下来的原锅炉。[S7]

外壳半径和长度属于展示设计，不是制造或操作锅炉的指导。[S1]

summary.en: Receives heat and supplies water vapour.
summary.zh: 吸收热量，产生水蒸气。

detail.en: Water can change from liquid to vapour. The fixed water level is a visual aid, not a calculated inventory or a temperature reading. [S9][S1]
detail.zh: 水可从液态变成气态。固定的液面帮助读图，不是计算出的水量，也不表示温度。[S9][S1]

summary.en: Transfers heat towards the boiler water.
summary.zh: 把热量传向锅炉里的水。

detail.en: The furnace is outside the water space. Fuel supplies energy; the model does not calculate combustion, coal use or real engine efficiency. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 炉膛位于水的空间之外。燃料提供能量；模型没有计算燃烧、耗煤或实机效率。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Carries steam through the throttle to the valves.
summary.zh: 让蒸汽经过节流阀，流向配汽阀。

detail.en: The two pipe sections join at the throttle. Their layout is reconstructed to separate the supply from the exhaust and moving rods. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 两段供汽管在节流阀处连接。管路经过重建，把供汽、排汽和运动杆件分开。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Houses the steam-control disc.
summary.zh: 容纳控制供汽的阀片。

detail.en: The fixed hollow body stays joined to the supply pipe. The selectable disc inside changes angle in the independent static governor comparison. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 固定的中空阀体连接供汽管。里面可单独选择的阀片，在独立的调速器静态比较中改变角度。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Changes the opening available to steam.
summary.zh: 改变供蒸汽通过的开口。

detail.en:
The three static angles come from the model linkage. Opening is normalized by angle; it is not the same fraction of steam mass flow. [S1]

This disc is separate from the four distribution valves, which switch the cylinder connections. [S7]
detail.zh:
三档静态角度由模型连杆位置求得。开度按角度归一化，不代表相同百分比的蒸汽质量流量。[S1]

节流阀片与四个切换汽缸通路的配汽阀分开。[S7]

summary.en: Connects each cylinder end to supply or exhaust.
summary.zh: 把汽缸两端分别接到供汽或排汽通路。

detail.en: The fixed passages expose four independently selectable valve pieces. Port timing is an ideal switch from the calculated piston direction, not a measurement of Lap timing. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 固定通道露出四个可单独选择的阀芯。正时按计算出的活塞方向作理想切换，不是 Lap 蒸汽机的实测正时。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Lets steam enter above the piston.
summary.zh: 让蒸汽进入活塞上方。

detail.en: The upper inlet is a separate lifted valve piece. It shares the calculated direction and gate with the fixed steam route. The 0.015 m lift is display design, not historical timing. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 这个上进汽阀是独立抬起的阀芯，与固定蒸汽路径共用计算出的方向和门控。0.015 米升程为展示设计，不是历史实测正时。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Lets steam enter below the piston.
summary.zh: 让蒸汽进入活塞下方。

detail.en: The lower inlet is a separate lifted valve piece. It shares the calculated direction and gate with the fixed steam route. The 0.015 m lift is display design, not historical timing. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 这个下进汽阀是独立抬起的阀芯，与固定蒸汽路径共用计算出的方向和门控。0.015 米升程为展示设计，不是历史实测正时。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Connects the upper space to the condenser.
summary.zh: 把上部空间接到冷凝器。

detail.en: The upper exhaust is a separate lifted valve piece. It shares the calculated direction and gate with the fixed steam route. The 0.015 m lift is display design, not historical timing. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 这个上排汽阀是独立抬起的阀芯，与固定蒸汽路径共用计算出的方向和门控。0.015 米升程为展示设计，不是历史实测正时。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Connects the lower space to the condenser.
summary.zh: 把下部空间接到冷凝器。

detail.en: The lower exhaust is a separate lifted valve piece. It shares the calculated direction and gate with the fixed steam route. The 0.015 m lift is display design, not historical timing. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 这个下排汽阀是独立抬起的阀芯，与固定蒸汽路径共用计算出的方向和门控。0.015 米升程为展示设计，不是历史实测正时。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Holds steam on either side of the piston.
summary.zh: 让蒸汽分别作用在活塞两面。

detail.en:
ASME records a Lap bore of 18.75 in, about 0.476 m; the Birmingham catalogue records 18 in, or 0.4572 m. Both record a 4 ft stroke, about 1.219 m. The disagreement is retained without guessing its cause. [S3][S4][S16]

The closed top has a rod opening. The display clearance is enlarged; this is not a manufacturing drawing. [S1]
detail.zh:
ASME 记录 Lap 内径为 18.75 英寸，约 0.476 米；伯明翰目录另记 18 英寸，即 0.4572 米。两者均记行程 4 英尺，约 1.219 米。这里保留差异，不猜测原因。[S3][S4][S16]

密封上盖留有活塞杆孔。显示间隙已经放大，这不是制造图。[S1]

summary.en: Receives the net pressure force.
summary.zh: 承受两侧压力产生的合力。

detail.en:
Steam alternately acts on either face. The rod occupies part of the upper face, and outside air acts on the exposed rod end; the pressure table includes these areas. [S8][S1]

The radial display clearance is 3 mm. Its slight sideways motion is retained rather than hidden. [S1]
detail.zh:
蒸汽轮流作用在活塞两面。上表面有一部分被杆占据，外界空气也作用在外露杆端；压强数表把这些面积一并计算。[S8][S1]

显示径向间隙为 3 毫米。机构造成的微小横移保留在画面中，没有被隐藏。[S1]

summary.en: Transfers push and pull to the linkage.
summary.zh: 把推力和拉力传给连杆机构。

detail.en:
A rigid rod connects the piston to point D of the parallel motion and passes through the upper cover. Unlike a chain, it can transmit force in either direction. [S6][S7]

Its model diameter is 0.040 m, a design input rather than a Lap measurement. [S1]
detail.zh:
刚性活塞杆把活塞接到平行运动机构的 D 点，并穿过上盖。它与链条不同，可以传递两个方向的力。[S6][S7]

模型杆径为 0.040 米，属于设计输入，不是 Lap 实测尺寸。[S1]

summary.en: Transfers motion between the two ends.
summary.zh: 在两端之间传递运动。

detail.en: A fixed central pivot supports the rigid beam. Its two sides rock together; the parallel links and connecting rod share this same calculated angle. [S6][S1]
detail.zh: 横梁由固定的中央支点支承。两端随同一个刚体摆动；平行机构与传动杆共用这一计算角度。[S6][S1]

summary.en: Joins C to E with one rigid link.
summary.zh: 用一根刚杆连接 C 点与 E 点。

detail.en: C–E is one side of the hinged parallelogram. There is no extra hinge halfway along it. All lengths are reconstructed design geometry. [S6][S1]
detail.zh: C–E 是铰接平行四边形的一边，中间没有额外铰链。杆长均为重建的设计尺寸。[S6][S1]

summary.en: Joins B to D opposite the inner link.
summary.zh: 连接 B 点与 D 点，与内侧杆相对。

detail.en: B–D remains parallel to C–E. The radius rod crosses it at a different depth without forming a joint. [S6][S1]
detail.zh: B–D 与 C–E 保持平行。摇杆在另一深度越过它，交叉处没有连接。[S6][S1]

summary.en: Closes the moving parallelogram.
summary.zh: 闭合运动中的平行四边形。

detail.en: E–D remains parallel to the beam segment C–B. Its endpoints are solved with the same frame, never moved by a separate sine wave. [S6][S1]
detail.zh: E–D 与横梁上的 C–B 段保持平行。两端由同一机构帧求解，不用独立的正弦动画代替。[S6][S1]

summary.en: Constrains E from a separate fixed pivot.
summary.zh: 从独立固定支点约束 E 点。

detail.en: F is fixed and E moves on a circular arc. Together with the parallelogram this guides the piston rod along a nearly straight path. The crossing with B–D is not a hinge. [S6]
detail.zh: F 点固定，E 点沿圆弧运动。它与平行四边形共同引导活塞杆沿近似直线运动；与 B–D 的交叉处不是铰链。[S6]

summary.en: Carries beam motion to the planet.
summary.zh: 把横梁运动传给行星轮。

detail.en: The planet is fixed to this rod at its lower end. It changes orientation with the rod instead of freely spinning about its own centre. [S6][S7]
detail.zh: 行星轮固定在传动杆下端，朝向随传动杆改变，并非绕自身中心自由转动。[S6][S7]

summary.en: Orbits the sun while fixed to the rod.
summary.zh: 随传动杆绕太阳轮运行。

detail.en: Equal model gears mesh without slip. A full piston cycle produces two net sun turns, while the planet returns to its initial orientation. Instantaneous speed ratio is not constant. [S6][S7][S1]
detail.zh: 两只相等的模型齿轮无滑动啮合。活塞完成一个周期时，太阳轮净转两圈，行星轮回到原朝向；瞬时速度比并不恒定。[S6][S7][S1]

summary.en: Turns the output shaft through gear contact.
summary.zh: 通过齿轮啮合带动输出轴。

detail.en: The sun is fixed to the shaft. Its phase follows the orbit and the rod-fixed planet together; it does not use a separate rotation animation. [S6][S1]
detail.zh: 太阳轮与输出轴固定。它的相位由轨道运动和固定在传动杆上的行星轮共同决定，不使用独立旋转动画。[S6][S1]

summary.en: Keeps the two gear centres apart.
summary.zh: 保持两齿轮的中心距。

detail.en: The link pivots at the sun and planet centres. It fixes their spacing while the gear teeth transmit rotation; it is not a substitute for meshing teeth. [S6][S1]
detail.zh: 定距连杆在太阳轮与行星轮中心转动，保持中心距；转动仍由齿轮啮合传递，连杆不能取代轮齿。[S6][S1]

summary.en: Carries rotation from sun to flywheel.
summary.zh: 把太阳轮的转动传给飞轮。

detail.en: The sun and flywheel share the shaft angle. Bearings support its axis. This model prescribes its phase rather than calculating shaft acceleration or load power. [S6][S1]
detail.zh: 太阳轮与飞轮共用输出轴角度，轴承支承轴线。模型按给定相位运动，没有计算轴的加速度或负载功率。[S6][S1]

summary.en: Stores and returns rotational energy.
summary.zh: 储存并交还转动的能量。

detail.en:
A flywheel can smooth changing motion by storing and releasing energy. The prescribed model speed is not a calculated demonstration of this effect. [S7][S1]

The reference diameter is 16 ft, about 4.88 m, reported by David K. Hulse. Sources disagree on outer drive-tooth count, so no countable outer tooth ring is drawn; the spokes are reconstruction. [S5][S3][S16]
detail.zh:
飞轮通过储存和释放能量，使运动较为平稳。模型速度由相位给定，并非算出了这种平滑效果。[S7][S1]

参考直径采用 David K. Hulse 报道的 16 英尺，约 4.88 米。来源所记外缘取力齿数不同，因此模型不画可数的外缘齿圈；辐条为重建。[S5][S3][S16]

summary.en: Supports the independent flyball comparison.
summary.zh: 支承独立的飞球比较模型。

detail.en: Real rotating governors respond through force and linkage. This spindle remains still in the three static comparisons; the schematic belt and right-angle take-off only mark a drive connection. No belt ratio or transient response is calculated. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 实际旋转调速器通过受力和连杆产生反馈。本模型的调速器轴在三档静态比较中不转动，示意皮带与直角取力只标明传动连接，没有计算传动比或瞬态响应。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Marks the radius in a static speed comparison.
summary.zh: 标出静态转速比较中的球半径。

detail.en:
The left ball is one of two symmetric point-mass model balls. Compare 60, 90 and 120 rpm as independent equilibria, not frames of acceleration. [S1]

The main engine phase and cold-side pressure do not drive this comparison. [S1]
detail.zh:
左球是对称点质量模型中的一球。60、90、120 转每分是独立平衡态，不是加速过程的连续画面。[S1]

主机相位和冷端压强不驱动这个比较。[S1]

summary.en: Marks the radius in a static speed comparison.
summary.zh: 标出静态转速比较中的球半径。

detail.en:
The right ball is one of two symmetric point-mass model balls. Compare 60, 90 and 120 rpm as independent equilibria, not frames of acceleration. [S1]

The main engine phase and cold-side pressure do not drive this comparison. [S1]
detail.zh:
右球是对称点质量模型中的一球。60、90、120 转每分是独立平衡态，不是加速过程的连续画面。[S1]

主机相位和冷端压强不驱动这个比较。[S1]

summary.en: Joins the fixed upper pivot to a ball.
summary.zh: 连接固定上支点与飞球。

detail.en: This rigid arm keeps its 0.5 m design length in every static position. The complete linkage changes instantly between solved equilibria, avoiding stretched intermediate rods. [S1]
detail.zh: 刚性杆在各静态姿态均保持 0.5 米设计长度。完整机构在求得的平衡态之间瞬切，避免中间状态拉长杆件。[S1]

summary.en: Joins the fixed upper pivot to a ball.
summary.zh: 连接固定上支点与飞球。

detail.en: This rigid arm keeps its 0.5 m design length in every static position. The complete linkage changes instantly between solved equilibria, avoiding stretched intermediate rods. [S1]
detail.zh: 刚性杆在各静态姿态均保持 0.5 米设计长度。完整机构在求得的平衡态之间瞬切，避免中间状态拉长杆件。[S1]

summary.en: Joins a ball to the sliding collar.
summary.zh: 连接飞球与滑套。

detail.en: This rigid arm keeps its 0.5 m design length in every static position. The complete linkage changes instantly between solved equilibria, avoiding stretched intermediate rods. [S1]
detail.zh: 刚性杆在各静态姿态均保持 0.5 米设计长度。完整机构在求得的平衡态之间瞬切，避免中间状态拉长杆件。[S1]

summary.en: Joins a ball to the sliding collar.
summary.zh: 连接飞球与滑套。

detail.en: This rigid arm keeps its 0.5 m design length in every static position. The complete linkage changes instantly between solved equilibria, avoiding stretched intermediate rods. [S1]
detail.zh: 刚性杆在各静态姿态均保持 0.5 米设计长度。完整机构在求得的平衡态之间瞬切，避免中间状态拉长杆件。[S1]

summary.en: Moves along the governor spindle.
summary.zh: 沿调速器轴升降。

detail.en: In this symmetric model the collar rises as the prescribed static speed increases. This direction follows the chosen geometry; historical lever arrangements can differ. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 在这个对称模型中，指定静态转速升高时滑套上升。方向取决于本设计几何，历史机器的杠杆配置可能不同。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Follows the collar without orbiting the shaft.
summary.zh: 随滑套升降，不绕轴公转。

detail.en: The fork sits in the collar groove and passes its vertical position to the throttle rod. It does not rotate around the spindle with the balls. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 叉环进入滑套槽，把升降位置传给节流连杆。它不随飞球绕调速器轴公转。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Joins the collar fork to the throttle crank.
summary.zh: 连接滑套叉环与节流曲柄。

detail.en: The model selects a circle intersection for each static position. The rod keeps its design length instead of stretching between interpolated points. [S1]
detail.zh: 模型为每个静态姿态选择圆交点，使连杆保持设计长度，不在插值过程中拉长。[S1]

summary.en: Turns the throttle about its fixed axis.
summary.zh: 绕固定阀轴带动节流阀片。

detail.en: The crank joins the throttle rod to the disc axis. It turns with the independent disc while the surrounding body stays fixed. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 曲柄把节流连杆连接到阀片轴，与独立阀片一起转动，周围的阀体保持固定。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Condenses exhaust steam away from the cylinder.
summary.zh: 在汽缸之外让排汽凝结。

detail.en:
Exhaust meets injected cold water here. Condensation releases heat and lowers the steam pressure; the air pump removes air and the water mixture. [S7][S9]

The module is a reconstructed injection condenser. The older illustration shows only the separation principle and cannot establish its internal jet. [S1][S14]
detail.zh:
排汽在这里接触喷入的冷水。凝结释放热量，并使蒸汽压强降低；抽气泵移走空气和混合水。[S7][S9]

这里重建喷射式冷凝器。旧插图只说明冷热分离，不能用来证明内部喷口构造。[S1][S14]

summary.en: Brings cold water into the condenser.
summary.zh: 把冷水喷入冷凝器内部。

detail.en: The water route ends at the mixing point inside the condenser. It does not spray into the working cylinder as in the atmospheric comparison. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 冷水路径在冷凝器内部的混合处结束，不像大气式比较模块那样直接喷入工作汽缸。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Supplies cold water around the condenser station.
summary.zh: 为冷凝工位提供冷水。

detail.en: The cistern has an external cold-water connection. Water and heat leave the system; the model is not a sealed loop that needs no outside supply. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 冷水箱设有外来冷水接口。水和热量会离开系统；这不是无需外来供水的密闭循环。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Removes air and mixed water from the condenser.
summary.zh: 从冷凝器移走空气和混合水。

detail.en: The beam drives the pump rod. The upstroke draws mixture in and delivers water above the piston; on descent the mixture transfers through a check passage. Valve details are schematic. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 横梁带动泵杆。上行时抽入混合物，并排出活塞上方的水；下降时，混合物经止回通道转移。阀门细节为示意。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Displaces mixture through the air pump.
summary.zh: 在抽气泵中推动混合物。

detail.en: This piston shares the main mechanism frame. Its movement is not a separate animation or a claim of constant pumping rate. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 泵活塞与主机共用机构帧；它不是独立动画，也不表示恒定抽送量。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Transfers beam motion to the air-pump piston.
summary.zh: 把横梁运动传给抽气泵活塞。

detail.en: A point inside the beam end drives a fixed-length rod and vertical pump slider. Both endpoints are solved with the same phase as the main piston. [S1][S7]
detail.zh: 横梁内侧取点通过定长杆驱动竖直泵滑块。两端与主活塞按同一相位求解。[S1][S7]

summary.en: Collects the discharged warm mixture.
summary.zh: 收集排出的温水。

detail.en: The hot well receives water from the air pump. Only part returns as boiler feed; an overflow makes the open water balance visible. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 热井接收抽气泵排出的水。只有部分水返回锅炉，溢流口让开放的水量关系可见。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Returns part of the hot-well water to the boiler.
summary.zh: 把热井中的部分水送回锅炉。

detail.en: The fixed small pump marks the feed route; this study does not solve its displacement or water flow rate. Outside water replaces what leaves the system. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 小型固定泵标出给水路线；本研究没有求出它的排量或水流量。外来水补充离开系统的水。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Join injection, discharge, return and overflow.
summary.zh: 连接注水、排水、回水与溢流。

detail.en: Separate pipe sections connect the condenser, air pump, hot well and boiler. Particle dots indicate routes, not molecules, temperature or mass flow. Pipe sizes and layout are reconstructed. [S7][S1]
detail.zh: 分开的管段连接冷凝器、抽气泵、热井和锅炉。小点表示路径，不表示分子、温度或质量流量；管径与布局经过重建。[S7][S1]

summary.en: Marks where rotation drives another machine.
summary.zh: 标出转动向其他机器传递的位置。

detail.en: The preserved Lap engine was used for metal polishing. This small take-off wheel represents mechanical drive, not an electricity generator or a measured load. [S2][S1]
detail.zh: 保存的 Lap 蒸汽机曾用于金属磨光。这个小取力轮只表示机械传动，不是发电机，也不代表实测负载。[S2][S1]

summary.en: Leaves the piston top open to the atmosphere.
summary.zh: 让活塞上方直接接触大气。

detail.en: Steam fills the lower chamber. Cold water condenses steam inside this cylinder, unlike Watt’s separate condenser. This is an independent principle module, not a replica of the museum’s later engine. [S11][S12][S1]
detail.zh: 蒸汽进入下部空间，冷水直接在缸内使蒸汽凝结，与瓦特的分离冷凝器不同。这是独立原理模块，不是博物馆晚期机器的复制品。[S11][S12][S1]

summary.en: Receives the atmospheric downward push.
summary.zh: 承受大气向下的推力。

detail.en: The lower pressure falls after condensation; air above pushes harder. A vacuum does not pull. This piston has no rod passing through a sealed upper cover, so the main-engine rod-area formula is not used. [S11][S8][S1]
detail.zh: 凝结后下方压强降低，上方空气推得更强；并非真空在拉。这个活塞没有穿过密封上盖的杆，因此不用主机的杆面积公式。[S11][S8][S1]

summary.en: Lifts the mine-pump rod as the piston descends.
summary.zh: 在活塞下降时提起矿井泵杆。

detail.en: Its curved end guides carry flexible chains. The poses show end states rather than measured timing, and omit the chain wrapped around the end arcs. [S11][S1]
detail.zh: 弧端引导柔性链条。姿态显示的是端态，不是实测时序；绕过弧端的一段链条省略不画。[S11][S1]

summary.en: Provides a weighted side for the return stroke.
summary.zh: 以沉重的泵侧帮助回程。

detail.en: When steam enters again, the weighted pump side helps raise the engine piston. Different mine-pump arrangements need not deliver water on the same stroke. [S11][S1]
detail.zh: 蒸汽再次进入时，沉重的泵侧帮助机缸活塞升起。不同矿井泵配置不一定在同一方向的行程排水。[S11][S1]

summary.en: Transfers tension at the cylinder-side arc.
summary.zh: 在汽缸侧弧端传递拉力。

detail.en: The exposed flexible segment changes length between poses, while the piston and its rod stay rigid. A chain can pull but cannot push upwards like a rigid link. [S11][S6][S1]
detail.zh: 姿态切换时，外露柔性链段改变长度，活塞与活塞杆保持刚性。链条能拉，不能像刚杆那样向上推。[S11][S6][S1]

summary.en: Transfers tension at the pump-side arc.
summary.zh: 在泵侧弧端传递拉力。

detail.en: This chain stays between the fixed vertical tangent and the pump rod top. Its exposed length follows the same beam angle as the opposite side. [S11][S1]
detail.zh: 链段始终连接固定竖直切点与泵杆顶端，外露长度与另一侧按同一横梁角度计算。[S11][S1]

summary.en: Sprays cold water directly into the open cylinder.
summary.zh: 把冷水直接喷入开口汽缸。

detail.en: The jet highlights the repeated cooling of the cylinder. Steam must then warm that cylinder again. The separate supply stub and jet are fixed, not carried by the piston. [S11][S12][S1]
detail.zh: 喷口说明汽缸被反复冷却，之后蒸汽又要把汽缸加热。独立供汽短管与喷口固定，不随活塞移动。[S11][S12][S1]

summary.en: Shows heat delivered to the working fluid.
summary.zh: 显示传给工作流体的热量。

detail.en: The separate input row has 100 normalized units. It represents working-fluid heat input, not all chemical energy in the fuel. [S1][S10]
detail.zh: 独立输入排为 100 份归一化单位，表示传给工作流体的热量，不是燃料中的全部化学能。[S1][S10]

summary.en: Shows the model share leaving as work.
summary.zh: 显示模型中以功输出的份数。

detail.en: The work row shows 10, 20 or 30 normalized units. These are teaching accounts rather than efficiency measurements of the Lap engine. [S1][S10]
detail.zh: 输出功一排显示 10、20 或 30 份归一化单位，属于教学账本，不是 Lap 蒸汽机的效率测量。[S1][S10]

summary.en: Completes the output account as rejected heat.
summary.zh: 以排出热量补全输出账本。

detail.en: Rejected heat is 90, 80 or 70 units. Work plus rejection equals the separate input of 100 for a complete cycle with no net stored-energy change. [S1][S10]
detail.zh: 排出热量为 90、80 或 70 份。完整循环的储能净变化为零，功加排热等于独立的 100 份输入。[S1][S10]

summary.en: Supports the beam pivot and output bearings.
summary.zh: 支承横梁支点与输出轴承。

detail.en: The timber and metal frame makes fixed pivots visible. Its members and bearing layout are reconstruction, not a digital twin of the museum object. [S2][S1]
detail.zh: 木架与金属支架使固定支点可见。构件和轴承布局经过重建，不是馆藏机器的数字孪生。[S2][S1]

summary.en: Supports the main demonstration station.
summary.zh: 支承主机展示工位。

detail.en: This display base separates the engine from the ground plane. Its dimensions are reconstructed and not a historical engine-house footprint. [S1]
detail.zh: 展示底座把主机与地面分开。尺寸为重建，并非历史厂房的占地范围。[S1]

summary.en: Supports the boiler clear of the furnace.
summary.zh: 使锅炉由支座承托。

detail.en: The schematic masonry seats carry the boiler. Their spacing and appearance are display design. [S1]
detail.zh: 示意砌体支座承托锅炉，间距与外形属于展示设计。[S1]

summary.en: Supports the independent atmospheric comparison.
summary.zh: 支承独立的大气式比较模型。

detail.en: The comparison is placed on its own stand. Its position and scale do not imply that it was part of the Lap installation. [S1]
detail.zh: 比较模型放在独立支架上。位置与比例不表示它原本属于 Lap 装置。[S1]

label.zh: 冷端压强 · 千帕绝压
